messages:
Teresa L: Quick kickoff — we need a tight benchmark narrative for next week's launch focused on latency vs cost. High-level ask: 3 distinct chart approaches, headline copy for each, and routing rules for inbound leads. Goal is clear CTA split: self-serve vs sales.
Matt G: I can spin chart mocks today. Thinking: 1) sequence-length slices, 2) customer-slice (chat vs batch), 3) economic waterfall (latency -> batching -> $/1M tokens).
Elaine: Sequence-length slices are highest signal for engineers. Also propose a single-slide ‘savings ladder’ showing batching + KV cache effects.
Srini: Agree. Also want a micro-graphic that explains fallback routing: if hosted capacity high latency -> auto-fallback to dedicated variant (show cost delta). Keeps reliability story in the econ frame.
Josh: For CTAs — A) "Try hosted free tier" (self-serve) and B) "Request Dedicated eval" (sales). Routing: any trial user with >100k tokens/day gets an inbound to sales@redwood with tag "dedicated-consider".
Teresa L: Good. Can we make the 3 chart headlines pithy? Drafts: 1) "Latency by sequence: where inference costs bite" 2) "Workload slices: chat vs batch economics" 3) "From latency to dollars: how caching & batching pay off"
Matt G: Drafted quick specs: 
```
Chart A (sequence slices): x=sequence length bins (0-64,65-256,257-1024), y=ms/token and $/1M tokens overlay (dual axis)
Chart B (workload): two-group bar for chat vs batch showing latency and $/1M tokens under same model + quantized variant
Chart C (waterfall): baseline latency/cost -> after batching -> after cache -> after quantization (stacked savings)
```
Elaine: Nice. Small UX ask: make Chart A color-blind safe and label sample queries per bin (e.g., search snippet, email draft, long doc).
Srini: For messaging iteration, plan an A/B: A = engineer-focused (numbers + config tips), B = product-focused (customer outcomes + CTA). We'll run both on landing and track conversion and lead quality.
Teresa L: Routing rules — draft: trial -> marketing nurture for 7 days; if daily tokens >100k or org.email domain in enterprise list -> route to sales w/ automated note including the chart snapshot and observed qps. ops-bot can automate the tagging.
ops-bot: (automated) Noted: will create a workflow named "bench-launch-routing" and emit an event to #crm when criteria met.
Josh: Webinar hook idea: "Cut inference costs without losing latency" — gated signup, include a small interactive chart that lets people slide sequence length and see cost delta. Routes heavy attendees to SDR queue.
Matt G: Timeline: chart mocks ready EOD today, copy for landing and webinar by tomorrow noon, A/B ready for deploy by Wed.
Teresa L: Perfect. Action owners: Matt=charts, Elaine=accessibility + sample queries, Srini=A/B setup + metrics, Josh=CTA + routing spec. I'll consolidate into a single PR and post the slide draft. Anything else?
Elaine: Add 1 small note: include a short footnote about model variants used and baseline hardware so econ numbers aren't misinterpreted.
Teresa L: Yes — baseline = LlamaX-7B (fp16), NVIDIA-H100 perf profile, and sample token costs. I'll add that to the slide notes.
Josh: 👍 I'll prep the inbound filter list and update the CRM mapping after ops-bot workflow is live.
Teresa L: Thanks team — I'll drop the PR link here when ready.
